## Contract Workspace (CW)

One contract’s whole paper trail on one surface: signature state, the Clause Navigator, executed version history, and modification papers — live-queried so paper created anywhere shows up without manual wiring.

### Args (the consumer declares the domain; the block only renders)

`@contract` (Contract) — the one card under review; `@context` — for live queries over ContractClause / ContractVersion / Amendment / Addendum / Waiver in the contract's own realm; `@onOpen(card)` — the consumer decides how a clicked row opens (stack, panel, nothing).

### Consumers

Contract Execution App — Workspace tab (over the picked contract). Second consumer: any Contract detail surface that wants the clause navigator and paper trail without the app shell.

### Non-goals

Not a contract EDITOR — every action routes through the commands (Request Signature, Execute, Amend). Not mounted into the shared contract.gts isolated in v1 (additive follow-up on that block).
